entities.name: Anafenza Mevak
entities.description: Valiant Abzan woman from Tarkir; Khan in the original timeline and an ancestral spirit in the current one.

entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: Krumar cousin who rescued her in the original timeline.

entities.name: Oret
entities.description: Traitor in the original timeline; her loyal captain in the current one.

entities.name: Kwaro
entities.description: Anafenza's captain of the guard in the original timeline.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: Dromoka soldier who discovered her Kin-Tree.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: Clan to whom her family was betrayed.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: Clan Anafenza protected her people from.

entities.name: Mer-Erk
entities.description: Fortress from which she led her army.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which her spirit defended Tarkir.

events.summary: Anafenza's family is betrayed to the Sultai; her parents and uncle are slaughtered and Gvar rescues her.
events.quote: Anafenza watched her parents and uncle be slaughtered before her Krumar cousin Gvar Barzeel rescued her.

events.summary: At her coronation as Khan she disowns Oret.
events.quote: Anafenza publicly and spiritually disowned Oret from her family.

events.summary: In the current timeline she kills Gvar in battle and is executed by Oret to save her soul.
events.quote: to save her soul, Oret volunteered to execute her

events.summary: She returns as an ancestral spirit with Oret carving her name into a new ancestor tree.
events.quote: she returned to the plane as an ancestral spirit herself

events.summary: Felothar discovers her Kin-Tree and learns of ancient clans from her.
events.quote: Felothar spoke with Anafenza and her ancestors

events.summary: Her spirit defends Tarkir during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The spirit of Anafenza fought in defense of Tarkir during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: cousin she calls brother in the original timeline
relations.quote: acknowledging her Krumar cousin, Gvar as her brother and true family

relations.note: her Captain in the current timeline
relations.quote: Oret remained loyal to her, and worked as her Captain
until she was elected as Khan
she in turn was the one to kill Gvar
